name: MCP Connector for wp2ai – Edit, Audit and Publish Safely with ChatGPT & Claude
author: webNdev

sections.description:
wp2ai is a WordPress MCP server that protects your sites from AI mistakes. Connect ChatGPT or Claude from their official directories, or any MCP assistant, and manage your content from the conversation while you stay in control of what goes live.

Unlike MCP plugins that only connect your AI to WordPress, wp2ai checks every change before it goes live and lets you undo it in one click.

What your AI can do

  • Read your posts and pages, and edit them in place, block by block, without touching the rest of the page (Gutenberg, Classic Editor, Elementor including the Atomic Editor, Bricks).
  • Create drafts, update titles, slugs, excerpts, categories, tags and featured images, and manage your media library.
  • Read and write SEO titles and meta descriptions in Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, All in One SEO and Squirrly SEO.
  • Audit existing content with up to 30 checks: incomplete pages, missing SEO, broken links, poorly structured posts, orphan and outdated content, internal linking suggestions.
  • Simulate a publication against these checks before publishing it.

Safeguards

  • Changes to published content wait for your approval in the wp2ai app, with a detailed analysis. Automatic mode can be turned on site by site.
  • A WordPress revision is created before each change, and every action can be undone in one click.
  • Per-site protection rules: a daily action limit and control over media deletion.
  • Editorial instructions (tone, structure, length) are sent to your AI at the start of every session.
  • All your sites in one multi-site view, with rights per user and per site for teams.

Freemium and Premium

  • Freemium: create an account and get Pro features included for 14 days, no credit card required. After that, you keep MCP access for one site, without checks, approval, history or dashboard. 20 actions per month, trial included.
  • Premium (Solo, Pro and Agency plans): unlimited actions, approval or automatic publishing with one-click undo, action history, editorial instructions, protection rules, and checks before every change, with simulation and a health score (12 checks on Solo, 30 from Pro, including SEO and quality). Pro adds up to 3 sites with a multi-site view, internal linking, and detection of broken links, orphan and outdated content. Agency adds up to 20 sites, 5 users with separate AI access, access rights and protection rules per user and per site, shared editorial instructions and a weekly report per site. Plans and prices: https://wp2ai.io/#pricing

External services

This plugin is the connector to wp2ai, a hosted service operated by webNdev: an account is required. Nothing is sent until an administrator connects the site from the plugin page, and nothing more is sent once the disconnection has been confirmed to wp2ai.

  • wp2ai API (api.wp2ai.app): once the site is connected, the plugin sends the content and metadata of your posts and pages (text, SEO fields, images, page structure), the site settings and versions, change notifications and technical error reports, so that wp2ai can analyze your content. It receives the changes your AI requests and reports whether they were applied. If connecting the site fails, the plugin page sends a technical report once, from your browser, to help find the cause.
  • wp2ai app (app.wp2ai.io): the “Connect my site” button opens it in your browser so you can sign in and authorize the site.
  • Images from a web address: when your AI asks to add an image from a URL, the plugin downloads that file from the address given to add it to your media library.

No visitor data, user accounts or email addresses are sent. Terms of service: https://wp2ai.io/terms. Privacy policy: https://wp2ai.io/privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to the wp2ai menu entry in the WordPress admin.
  3. Click “Connect my site”. You are sent to app.wp2ai.io to sign in and authorize the site.
  4. You are returned to the plugin page and the connection is finalized automatically.

To stop the connection, click Disconnect on the same page. The plugin notifies the service and removes the stored credentials.
sections.faq:
Is a wp2ai account required?

Yes. The plugin connects your site to the hosted wp2ai service and does nothing on its own.

Which AI assistants are compatible?

ChatGPT and Claude from their official directories, and any assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP), such as Gemini or Copilot.

Are my existing sites compatible?

Yes, from WordPress 6.0. The plugin installs in two minutes without modifying your theme or your other plugins.

Can an AI publish to my site without my consent?

Not on a paid plan: every change to published content waits for your approval by default and can be undone in one click, unless you turn on automatic mode. On the Free plan, actions are applied directly. Content sent by your AI is sanitized before it is saved.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

The connection credentials and plugin settings are removed from your site. Data held by wp2ai stays manageable from your wp2ai account.
